bifrost: springboard/src/net/share.rs (custom UDP beacon, not DNS-SD), springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (share sheet only)
summary: The dnssd C API (DNS-SD over mDNS and unicast DNS) has no BifrOSt counterpart. The only LAN discovery is a custom UDP multicast beacon in share.rs (group 224.0.0.251:5354, format TSB1) that finds other BifrOSt machines sharing the same secret; it uses no DNS records, service types or TXT data, and no app-facing discovery API exists.

features.note: Peer list is built from the TSB1 beacon only. Finds BifrOSt peers with the same secret, not arbitrary DNS-SD service types. No app API.

features.feature: Resolve a service to host, port and TXT (DNSServiceResolve)
features.note: The beacon gives address, TCP port and device name. There is no TXT data and no resolve call that apps can make.
Advertises a fixed beacon with name, port and fingerprint every 2 s. Only the share service registers; apps cannot advertise their own service type or name.

features.feature: Custom records on a service (AddRecord, UpdateRecord, RemoveRecord, RegisterRecord)
features.note: No DNS resource record sets are built or published.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/deildu/http.rs:27 (Tls, UDP resolver for the tracker client)
features.note: The UDP resolver is private to the tracker HTTP client and is not exposed to apps. It does not run mDNS or multicast queries.

features.feature: Resolve hostnames to IPv4 and IPv6 (DNSServiceGetAddrInfo)
features.note: No app-facing address lookup. The private resolver is used only for HTTPS fetches.

features.feature: TXT record construction and parsing (TXTRecordCreate, TXTRecordSetValue, TXTRecordGetValuePtr and the rest)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-19, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The beacon uses its own fixed binary layout and has no TXT key/value encoding.

features.feature: Connection and reference lifecycle (DNSServiceRef, ProcessResult, RefSockFD, SetDispatchQueue, RefDeallocate)
features.apple: DNSServiceRef, DNSServiceProcessResult, DNSServiceRefSockFD, DNSServiceSetDispatchQueue, DNSServiceRefDeallocate, DNSServiceCreateConnection
features.note: No DNSServiceRef or daemon connection exists. The SDK dispatch module does not drive DNS-SD sockets.
Searched for NAT-PMP, PCP, UPnP and IGD in springboard/src, springboard/netd and springboard/sdk/src: no hits.
No domain browsing or registration-domain lookup.

features.feature: Error codes, flags and interface indices (kDNSServiceErr_*, kDNSServiceFlags*, kDNSServiceInterfaceIndex*)
features.apple: DNSServiceErrorType, DNSServiceFlags, DNSServiceProtocol, kDNSServiceInterfaceIndexAny and related constants
features.note: The beacon uses its own error results and no DNS-SD flags or interface indices are exposed.

features.feature: Multicast DNS and DNS-SD wire protocol on port 5353
features.apple: dnssd C API over mDNSResponder (RFC 6762, RFC 6763 wire format)
features.note: No code sends or parses mDNS packets or DNS-SD PTR, SRV and TXT records. The share beacon interoperates only with BifrOSt peers.

gaps: No app-facing DNS-SD API: apps cannot browse, resolve or advertise arbitrary service types (for example _ipp._tcp or _airplay._tcp).
No mDNS on port 5353 and no DNS-SD PTR/SRV/TXT records, so ordinary LAN devices cannot find BifrOSt and BifrOSt cannot find them.
No TXT record encoding or parsing.
No DNSServiceRef-style connection to a discovery daemon, and no dispatch-queue integration for discovery callbacks.
No NAT port mapping (NAT-PMP, PCP or UPnP) and no domain enumeration.
The share beacon (springboard/src/net/share.rs) is a BifrOSt-only protocol with a fixed secret model. It could be the base for a DNS-SD-compatible layer, but that is a separate decision.
